name: toggle-06
description: A controlled toggle whose pressed state is driven and displayed from outside.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { BellIcon, BellOffIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Toggle } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle" export default function ControlledToggleStatus() { const [pressed, setPressed] = React.useState(false) return (
{pressed ? : } Do not disturb {pressed ? "On" : "Off"}
) }
